title: Side-by-Side Pricing Plans: How to Control the Width of Each Pricing Column
text:
## Side-by-Side Pricing Plans: How to Control the Width of Each Pricing Column
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000034724
In this article learn how to align the pricing tables into one line using simple CSS classes that can be applied to the Pricing Menu located in the Menu Manager.

## 4 Pricing Packages
Add the " col-md-3 " class:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12073836925/original/yr3WnX_OeoxSLzNCe1qvq5WV4ArKdIq_iQ.png?1581436748 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180590403/original/DeNhkmTTV5DPSWe1rohEvB3CkCfZUcMQMA.png?1781711275 | alt: ]
